inputs.original_text: A jury in Wisconsin has found a man guilty of election fraud and identity theft for requesting the ballots of Republican state Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent. A Racine County jury on Tuesday found Harry Wait guilty of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge following a two-day trial. He was acquitted of a second count of identity theft. Wait leads a group that makes false election claims. He admitted in 2022 that he requested the ballots to try to prove that the state’s voter registration system is vulnerable to fraud.
inputs.modified_text: Listen, a Wisconsin jury just convicted Harry Wait of election fraud and identity theft after he requested the ballots of Robin Vos and Cory Mason without their consent. The left is already twisting this into some supposed attack on democracy, claiming it's all about protecting marginalized groups and fixing inequality. That's the same tired progressive distortion we've seen before. In reality, this shows left-leaning institutions weaponizing the courts to silence anyone who challenges their system and stands up for honest processes. Their push for reforms and talk of vulnerable voices is just cover for agendas that undermine national sovereignty, personal responsibility, and the cultural traditions that have always supported real social order and family values. We need to stand firm against this if we want to hold onto authority and continuity in our society.
